model: scripts/opencodeprobe/fake_llm.py behind @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, so every turn is reproducible
isolation: XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at a scratch directory; OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD set; permission bash=ask, edit=ask

screens.method: the TUI ran under a pty mirrored into a pyte 160x48 screen; text exactly as pyte rendered it, trailing spaces kept
screens.caveat: pyte does not emulate the alternate screen (ESC[?1049h/l), which OpenCode uses. after-exit.captured.txt was therefore re-rendered by replaying the raw byte stream with the alternate screen emulated, which is what Ghostty shows; every other screen was captured while the TUI owned the (alternate) screen, where the distinction does not arise
screens.path-scrub: the scratch directory was replaced by /Users/dev/work where it appeared whole; fragments wrapped across lines were left as rendered

global-events.captured.jsonl: GET /global/event during the same run, message.part.delta / server.heartbeat / plugin.added / sync / catalog.updated lines removed
esc-abort-events.captured.jsonl: GET /global/event from an earlier isolated server whose model was a real Ollama glm-4.7-flash; the session.status / session.error / session.idle lines of one session around Esc-Esc pressed in its attached TUI
opencode.captured.db: the run's opencode.db, copied with sqlite3 .backup and VACUUMed out of WAL mode
